verdict.rationale: Customer risk scoring is a fair question for an AML/compliance case-management platform, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents configurable customer risk factors, a risk score, or an explanation of why a score changed. The closest items are generic: 'customizable automation' for screening and ongoing monitoring, configurable workflows, and a general audit trail of work. These are adjacent features, not this capability.

support.subject: As a compliance-officer, I can configure customer risk factors and inspect why the risk score changed
